# Tarzıyla Anlat

> Tarzıyla Anlat is a free, open-source charades-style party game for friends. Draw a WORD card and a STYLE card, act the word out in a silly style without saying it, and let the others guess. It plays in English and Turkish, works offline, and collects no data. / Arkadaşlarla oynanan ücretsiz, açık kaynaklı, komik bir kelime anlatma oyunu (Türkçe ve İngilizce).

Key facts:
- Genre: party game, charades, word-guessing game, acting game
- Players: 2 to 8 players or teams, one phone passed around
- Modes: Classic (guesser and actor both score) and Competitive (teams race the clock)
- Content: 639 English words and 211 English styles; 621 Turkish words and 219 Turkish styles
- Platforms: any browser (installable PWA), Android APK, iPhone via the web app
- Price: free. No ads, no accounts, no analytics
- License: MIT (code and cards); font Paytone One under SIL OFL
